rootCauses: Transform hit targets were smaller and mixed corner and edge semantics.
Selection geometry and rotated local deltas were not consistently aligned.
Note operations did not share the complete item history snapshot.
Ctrl-right-drag was explicitly routed to camera pan.
Legacy crop changed item geometry instead of maintaining a fixed frame viewport.
automationLimitations: The available pointer drag interface cannot keep Shift or Alt held throughout a drag.
Modifier paths therefore require routed WPF diagnostics plus pure geometry tests in addition to actual pointer checks.
